mentions.h: LANGLEY wins Surrey Boys 880y: Juniors take 4x110
WELLER TAKES '5¾' — AUTUMN 5¾-MILES ROAD RACE, WIMBLEDON, September 18, 1971

photos.c: Richard Langley leads Chris Taylor (Mitcham) in the Surrey County Youth 3,000m at Wimbledon Park. He finished 6th in 9:36.2.
